notes: One shared power scale across franchises; no BLEACH-specific calibration.
These are proposed NIGHT assessments, not official rankings or a completed canonical feat audit.
Finishes do not grant rank. Every acquired form is explicitly assessed; unknown forms remain pending, never F by default.
Human Ichigo is F. An adult, released, transformed or later-arc version never transfers its power to another form.
Rank reflects combat capability, speed, defence, special abilities and their limits rather than popularity or rarity.
SSS is reserved for sufficiently evidenced world/reality-scale forms; no existing portrait is forced into that band.
